metadata.search_method: Exa: 35 search result slots across four angles, then current system1 verification and source reads. Not exhaustive.
metadata.cutoff_policy: No material published after the observed research cutoff is admitted. Publication and observation dates are separate. No October 18 end-of-day assumption.

facts.confidence: Medium; multiple sources, no executed transaction
facts.model_implication: Scenario reference only. Neither amount replaces the completed $965B financing benchmark.

facts.confidence: High that company announced it; not audited annual revenue
facts.model_implication: Historical pace metric. Do not enter as FY2026 actual revenue.

facts.confidence: High that company announced it; measurement period vague

facts.confidence: Medium-high reporting confidence, underlying figure unaudited here

facts.confidence: Medium-high reporting confidence

facts.confidence: Medium-high; investor-day figures, reconciliation unavailable

facts.confidence: Medium-high reporting confidence
facts.model_implication: Do not align this older quarter with Anthropic Q3 as a same-period comparison.

facts.confidence: High reporting quality; confidential prospectus not directly reviewed
facts.model_implication: Net loss is not cash burn; financing remeasurement dominates. December liquidity cannot be used as an October cash balance.

facts.confidence: Medium; reputable secondary coverage of leaked statements reviewed by FT
facts.model_implication: Keep annual realized revenue separate from exit run-rate. Training/R&D and serving costs must both be covered in modeled operating cash flows.

facts.confidence: High reporting quality; source prospectus not directly reviewed
facts.model_implication: Fees are reported in sales/marketing/partnerships expense. The ~16% fee applies to channel sales, not all revenue. Gross margin and revenue multiples need common definitions.

facts.confidence: High; primary bilateral summary
facts.model_implication: Do not carry old reciprocal royalties or exclusivity into forecast. Percentage and cap are not disclosed in this primary summary.

facts.confidence: High for announced scope; future tranche conditional

facts.confidence: High for announced terms; conditions and latest disbursement not verified

facts.confidence: High reporting quality; accounting classification and payment schedule incomplete
facts.model_implication: Mixed service floors, leases and cancelable capacity. Do not subtract $518B from EV as debt; schedule relevant costs and avoid double counting existing forecast expense.

facts.confidence: Medium-low; FT sources relayed by Reuters

facts.confidence: Medium-high that FT reported the presentation; not an outcome forecast endorsement
facts.model_implication: Use as a funding-needs stress case, not cash burn already incurred or disclosed guidance. $350B is a reported 2030 projection.
